{"code":"def transform(grid):
 g=[r[:] for r in grid]
 from collections import Counter
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
 cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=0)
 singles=[x for x,n in cnt.items() if n==1]
 if not singles:return g
 marker=singles[0]
 mr=mc=next((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==marker)
 # choose a plausible center: unique 8 if present, otherwise the central cell of the dominant pattern
 centers=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==8]
 if centers: cr,cc=centers[0]
 else:
  # use centroid/central singleton axis cell among most frequent color
  mx=max(cnt.values()); col=next(x for x,n in cnt.items() if n==mx)
  pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==col]
  cr=sum(i for i,j in pts)//len(pts); cc=sum(j for i,j in pts)//len(pts)
  # prefer an occupied point at this center
  if not (0<=cr<h and 0<=cc<w): return g
 dr,dc=mr-cr,mc-cc
 if dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc):
  for a,b in {(dr,dc),(-dr,dc),(dr,-dc),(-dr,-dc)}:
   rr,cc2=cr+a,cc+b
   if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc2<w:g[rr][cc2]=marker
 return g"}
